linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 / AMD Radeon R5 240
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible sound card
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible sound card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1 or M2 chip
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics or equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 / Apple M1 or M2 chip
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or Apple Silicon integrated GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 / GeForce GT 710 / Radeon R5 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card or onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: Stereo speakers recommended
